svg.title: Homepage wireframe
svg.text: Desktop 1440 and Mobile 390 · grayscale structure, numbered notes = design decisions
Photo opens from a rounded window to full bleed on load
Title block bottom-left so faces stay clear
Fixed side Donate tab on every screen
Quote: moving gradient, cursor glow, words rise in
6 pillar cards: icon beside title, darker outline
Rooted in the Bay Area, growing since 2012
Photo circles alternate with stat circles, level rows
Tabs + card grid; flyers shown whole
Plain ruled list (no cards, no initials)
← continuously scrolling, same-size photos, pauses on hover →
